newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch construction sector sets up Czech help desk.
newsitem.headline: Dutch construction sector sets up Czech help desk.

text.p: The information centre for the Dutch construction sector Bouwcentrum Expo said on Tuesday it had set up a Czech help desk.

The desk, which will be officially opened by the Czech Junior Housing Minister Tomas Kvapil next Thursday, will supply information and services to Dutch builders who want to become active in the Czech Republic.
The services include legal and fiscal advice, certifying products, market research and partner search.
Bouwcentrum Expo said its Czech counterpart ABF had set up a similar Dutch help desk in Prague.
The help desks are part of a project of the Dutch ministry of Economic Affairs, which is aimed at expanding commercial contacts between Dutch and Czech construction companies.
The project stimulates cooperation pacts and also focuses on eco-friendly building and renovation of flats.
